name: Gordon Matthews
text: We hired Jack of Kent Rendering Systems to apply monocouche render across two large properties, and we are absolutely delighted with the results. The quality of the finish is outstanding and has completely transformed the exteriors of both buildings. … We would not hesitate to use Jack's services again and highly recommend him to anyone looking for top-tier rendering.

name: Gavin Sweeting
text: We recently had Jack and his team replace the render on our home with Eco rend. So pleased we decided to do this it looks amazing. Jack is very knowledgeable in what he does. The finish is excellent  and I am over the moon with the results.

name: Katy Whitehead
text: I phoned Jack about having a coloured render system on my house. Jack was very knowledgable with the options and products available to us, as we had existing painted brickwork and render to cover over.

name: Iris
text: Jack was quick at coming round for a site visit and getting back to us with a price. He turned up on the days he said he would and at the time we agreed. Communication was spot on. We had the back and side of the house rendered, and he was careful to protect the areas I.e windows. He left a tidy site at the end of each day. The rendered walls look amazing and we couldn't be happier with the outcome. Would definitely recommend.

name: Carl Suter
text: I recently had my 3-bedroom property rendered by Jack and his team at Kent Render Systems, and I couldn't be happier with the results. From start to finish, they were professional, punctual, and incredibly hardworking. … I would highly recommend Kent Render Systems to anyone looking for reliable, skilled, and professional renderers.

name: Liam Guida
text: We recently had our house rendered, and the results are outstanding. From the initial quote through to the finished job, the team was professional, reliable, and took great pride in their work. Their attention to detail was exceptional, and they kept everything clean and tidy throughout the project.

name: Colleen Kadwill
text: Jack recently rendered our bungalow for us. We are so happy with the result. The finish is flawless. I cannot fault his service at all. He knows his stuff! Price was very good as well. I have had people knock my door to ask who done it for us and what product was used. Thanks again Jack.

name: Ebony Owen
text: We couldn't be happier with the transformation! Jack removed the old tiles from the front of our house and rendered it beautifully, giving it a clean, modern look. The quality of the workmanship is outstanding.

name: Dave Boorman
text: Jack and his team have rendered a couple of properties for me now and the work has always beeen to a very high standard, he's very easy to deal with and talked me through what was the best systems to use on the properties. From start to finish Jack was brilliant I highly recommend

name: Craig Deakin
text: Im a local builder in faversham and have used jack and the team for over 10 years, i highly recommend kent render systems if u want a quality clean job at an affordable price !!

name: Alex Wear, Wear Builders Kent Ltd
text: Kent Render Systems Ltd did a sub contract for me "Wear Builders Kent Ltd" they delivered on time with high quality workmanship and left site clean and tidy.  Thanks Jack.

name: Paula Guida
text: Jack and his team completed a render on my garden room. They did a fantastic job and were very clean workers and always extremely professional in their work and knowledge of the process.  I would not hesitate to recommend him.

name: Ivan Boorman
text: We had Jack and his team from Kent Render Systems renders our garden walls. An excellent job, very professional and very clean. They turned up on time everyday and also no delay in the date that was agreed on start to finish.

name: Mike Long
text: Jack and his team rendered my out building, very professional service from start to finish Would highly recommend

name: Ralph Bromley
text: Jack and his team have carried out multiple jobs for us. Always delivering a high standard, professional and tidy. Would have no hesitation recommending.

name: Richard Wyles
text: Would definitely recommend, clean, tidy and efficient.

name: Lee Pankurst
text: A great service and professional workmanship Highly  recommend
